mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.customer_key, u.username, u.password, u.email, u.phone, u.role, u.profile_image, u.zonecode, u.road_address, u.detail_address, sa.social_account_id, sa.provider FROM users u LEFT JOIN social_account sa ON sa.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT user_id, customer_key, username, email, password, phone, role, profile_image, zonecode, road_address, detail_address, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( user_id, customer_key, username, password, email, phone, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, role ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{customerKey}, #{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{modifiedAt}, #{modifiedBy}, #{role} )
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.customer_key, u.username, u.password, u.email, u.phone, u.profile_image, u.zonecode, u.road_address, u.detail_address, u.role, sa.social_account_id, sa.provider FROM social_account sa JOIN users u ON u.user_id = sa.user_id WHERE sa.provider = #{provider} AND sa.provider_id = #{providerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO social_account ( social_account_id, user_id, provider_id, provider, access_token, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{socialAccountId}, #{userId}, #{providerId}, #{provider}, #{accessToken}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{modifiedAt}, #{modifiedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE social_account SET access_token = #{accessToken}, modified_at = NOW() WHERE social_account_id = #{socialAccountId}
